integrity: All claims concerning infinite tree sizes are supported by an analytic proof; the finite checker is supplementary. The root-degree case is expressly credited to prior published work.
scientific_limitations: Covariance sign transitions do not establish stochastic ordering conditional on nonroot offspring counts.
The proof uses uniform independent attachment and does not cover weighted recursive trees.
Classical bivariate generating-function treatments may encode the same mixed first moments.
title: A square-root birth-age crossover in recursive-tree degree–path-length dependence
